notes: US 708: the same object was rediscovered by SDSS as SDSS J093320.86+441705.4 (T:p1-b13; T:p2-b1). The paper retains the explicit unbound conclusion (T:p1-b5; T:p3-b2; T:p4-b4); its rest-frame speed is quoted as 751 km s−1 in the abstract and analysis but 757 km s−1 in the conclusion, a numerical inconsistency that does not affect the unbound determination.

US 708: Predicted proper motions differ between T:p1-b5 (mu_alpha cos(delta)=-2.3, mu_delta=-2.4 mas/yr) and T:p3-b5/T:p4-b4 (-2.2, -2.6 mas/yr); both are retained. The Galactic rest-frame speed is 751 km/s in T:p3-b2 (abstract: at least 751) but at least 757 km/s in T:p4-b4; both are retained. T:p1-b5 gives 19 kpc, T:p3-b1 gives 19.3^{+3.1}_{-2.7} kpc, and T:p4-b4 restates about 20 kpc (rounded; not entered separately). T:p3-b4 cautions that the USNO-B1.0 proper-motion errors are too optimistic. T:p3-b2 uses a rounded galactocentric distance of 25 kpc for the escape-velocity comparison, whereas T:p3-b1 reports 25.8 kpc. No explicit equatorial coordinates are tabulated; the SDSS designation is treated as an identifier, so ra/dec are not extracted.
